# DEVX-005: Cursor guardrails rule

## Summary

'.cursor/rules/guardrails.mdc' (alwaysApply: true): When unsure about implementation details, read the relevant source files before proposing changes; Never modify generated files in 'dist/' or 'build/'; Never commit secrets or credentials; use env vars.
